analyses.method: Primary celestial TAN-SIP WCS, origin=0; A native pixel grid; scipy.ndimage.map_coordinates bilinear order=1; no fitted transform
analyses.mask_method: finite IMAGE and finite positive VARIANCE; retain informational SOURCE bit21; reject every other set bit; require all bilinear contributors valid
analyses.variance_interpretation: positive variance required; zero never treated as exact

background_source_matching.criteria: Native local maxima within 5x5, intensity > median+5*(1.4826*MAD); complete valid 5x5 kernel excludes edges and flags; radius >4 native pixels from M101 reference; project B with primary TAN-SIP onto A; mutual nearest neighbor <=2 A pixels. At least 3 spatially separated non-collinear matches and source identity review required for residual validation.
background_source_matching.interpretation: Insufficient candidate matches for independent residual validation; candidates are not identified stars and this does not prove absence of background sources.

analyses.residual_status: NOT_VALIDATED: bounded mutual-nearest peak matching produced insufficient independent field points; no residual fit justified; WCS inverse roundtrip is numerical consistency only, not astrometric accuracy
analyses.spectral_status: NOT_VALIDATED: half-bandwidth offset; approximation does not establish equal spectral response

observation_identity_note: OBSID alone is shared across detectors; pair order is verified against original exposure combinations and file names uniquely key arrays.
spatial_sip_policy: Retain primary TAN-SIP. Spectral alternate WCS cleaning must never be applied to celestial WCS.
warnings_policy: Captured Python warnings per observation; primary spatial CTYPE has -SIP and SIP coefficients are consistent. Alternate A/W may trigger Astropy informational SIP inconsistency logs if naively built; do not use those for spatial geometry.
scope: 11 local dated FITS, all 55 original pairs; two best pairs resampled only in memory; no original files or mosaic modified
